periods.label: Automaton of the Tunnel
periods.summary: Dog-eared automaton manager of the Fourth Ruins Tunnel. She greets Kururushifa and Lux, repairs a lodging space at Kururushifa's request, and reports that no invaders or new old-era survivors have been found.

kururushifa-enfolderk.summary: Serves and affectionately responds to Kururushifa.

lux-arcadia.summary: Welcomes him to the repaired ruins lodging.

key_events.summary: Prepares the warm starry lodging inside the Tunnel where Lux and Kururushifa spend the night.
